title: Misinformation Propagation in Benign Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.16710v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are credited with solving complex problems, yet their agents routinely act on context that may be false. Prior work shows single LLMs are swayed by false context, and MAS can be compromised by adversarial agents persuading peers. We study the benign case: agents follow one protocol, none intends to deceive, but some read a misleading passage. We study it with MINT, 10,278 LLM-written misinformation passages in eight styles, testing three open-weight models on commonsense reasoning, knowledge QA, and moral judgment. A relevant false passage costs a single agent 0.12-0.43 accuracy; irrelevant or content-free passages typically cost at most 0.06. Debate looks robust because uninformed agents outnumber misinformed ones. With one of three misinformed, it is no better than choosing the majority over equally exposed independent samples. Interaction helps only with a misinformed majority, recovering up to 0.24

translated_title: 良性多智能体系统中的错误信息传播
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）被认为能够解决复杂问题，但其智能体经常基于可能虚假的上下文采取行动。先前的研究表明，单个大语言模型会受到虚假上下文的影响，MAS也可能被对抗性智能体说服同伴而受到损害。我们研究的是良性情形：所有智能体遵循同一协议，没有任何智能体意图欺骗，但部分智能体读到了误导性段落。我们使用MINT进行研究——这是10,278个由大语言模型生成的、涵盖八种风格的错误信息段落，在常识推理、知识问答和道德判断任务上测试了三个开源权重模型。相关的虚假段落会使单个智能体的准确率下降0.12至0.43；不相关或无实质内容的段落通常最多造成0.06的损失。辩论之所以显得稳健，是因为未受错误信息影响的智能体数量多于受影响的智能体。当三个智能体中有一个受到误导时，其表现并不优于在同样暴露于错误信息的独立样本中选择多数结果。只有当多数智能体受到错误信息影响时，交互才有所帮助，最多可恢复0.24的准确率。
tldr: 本文提出MINT基准（包含10,278个八种风格的LLM生成错误信息段落），首次系统研究了无欺骗意图的良性多智能体系统中错误信息的传播影响，发现辩论的表面稳健性仅源于未受影响智能体的数量优势，交互只有在多数智能体被误导时才能带来最多0.24的准确率恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MINT, a benchmark of 10,278 LLM-written misinformation passages in eight styles, and presents the first systematic study of misinformation propagation in benign multi-agent systems without adversarial intent, revealing that debate's apparent robustness merely stems from uninformed agents outnumbering misinformed ones, and that interaction only helps when a misinformed majority exists, recovering up to 0.24 accuracy.
